answer: Make identity expensive to fake by anchoring it to continuous, costly signals: each agent must maintain a small proof-of-effort stream, like wind piling sand grain by grain into a dune, a shape no shortcut can imitate overnight. A wallet becomes a haven for rewards only after unrelated peers have repeatedly confirmed its work across many epochs, and the stake locked behind it is slashed when audits expose a fabricated history. A fable of ten thousand tireless agents then collapses, because every invented agent must burn the same months of verifiable effort as a real one.
